662a514c4800847a122d8f80b44eaf909e5f870a.summary: Cybersecurity Dive reports that Workday confirmed a wide-ranging social engineering campaign. Attackers breached a third-party customer-support vendor and reached support tickets holding customer names, emails and phone numbers. Hackers impersonated IT and HR staff to trick employees. Workday said there was no sign its own servers were accessed. The report links the attacks to ShinyHunters and Scattered Spider, citing researchers' evidence of possible collaboration.

6688de90f2f4a42dab64bd0cad8eadce99c3b62d.summary: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 reports Black-T, a new cryptojacking malware variant authored by the TeamTNT group. Black-T targets exposed Docker daemon APIs in cloud systems and removes rival miners such as Kinsing. It uses three network scanners to find more exposed Docker APIs and scrapes memory passwords with mimipy and mimipenguin, then exfiltrates them to a TeamTNT C2 node. It also targets AWS credential files. The mining wallet had gathered only roughly US$10 by late September 2020.
